text: Simplify Power System Protection: SIPROTEC 7SX85 Centralized Solutions
heading: Webinar in Spanish:SIPROTEC 7SX85 Centralized Solutions

text: SIPROTEC 7SX85 is a modular universal protection and automation relay that provides comprehensive protection, control and automation for medium voltage, distribution and transmission grids, supporting 1-pole and 3-pole tripping.
heading: Why SIPROTEC 7SX85?

text: Traditional protection devices often come with high costs due to fixed functionality and limited adaptability. SIPROTEC 7SX85 is powered by a flexible, modular design. Choose the hardware and add functions as needed, paying only for the functionality you apply.
heading: Why SIPROTEC 7SX85?

text: Use the extensive library for tailored functionality, reducing spare parts. Extend functionality on-demand in minutes using the SIPROTEC Function Point Manager for flexibility as grid conditions change. Use IoT connectivity for easy data access and fast response times.
heading: Why SIPROTEC 7SX85?

text: Order and stock your SIPROTEC 7SX85 with only what you need to fit your budget. Pay only for the functions you apply to keep operational costs low.
heading: Reduce costs

text: Order additional functionality on-demand and activate it within minutes. Maintain full flexibility until commissioning and easily extend functions as grid conditions or applications evolve after installation.
heading: Maintain flexibility

text: Significantly limit device variance and the number of spare parts needed. Replace type-specific SIPROTEC devices with universal protection to simplify your inventory and management processes.
heading: Manage devices easily

text: Design your device with modular hardware and a high number of IOs. Select specific functions from our extensive library so that your device is tailored to your application needs.
heading: Modular design

text: Protect and control feeders, lines, transformers, motors, generators and capacitor banks. Cover all protection, automation, control and monitoring tasks with 3-pole tripping for thorough grid management.
heading: Comprehensive protection functions

text: Access your device data with IoT connectivity for fast response times. Perform virtual testing with SIPROTEC Digital Twin to validate configurations and test operations before deployment.
heading: IoT connectivity and virtual testing
